name: Freshsales Suite
description: Freshsales Suite is Freshworks' unified sales and marketing CRM, combining sales pipeline management, marketing automation, chat, telephony, customer records, and AI-assisted engagement in one customer view.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Freshsales Suite connection or install. Use the canonical Freshsales provider for supported sales CRM and shared-record API actions, and the canonical Freshmarketer provider for any independently supported marketing-automation actions; the Suite is the commercial bundle and unified account experience, not a third public API authority.

blocked.label: Create a Freshsales Suite connection
blocked.description: Freshworks documents the Suite as an integrated Freshsales and Freshmarketer offering, not a third customer identity, credential type, API origin, or authorization grant for Relay.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Suite tools
blocked.description: Relay must not publish an overlapping Suite tool set beside the canonical Freshsales and Freshmarketer providers or duplicate their credentials, policies, and audit identities.

blocked.label: Route across Suite products implicitly
blocked.description: Sales CRM actions cannot silently imply marketing-journey, campaign, chat, telephony, or other Freshmarketer authority; every action remains bound to the selected canonical provider's documented surface and connected-user permissions.

blocked.label: Send or automate communications through the alias
blocked.description: Campaigns, marketing journeys, sales sequences, bulk email, SMS, WhatsApp, chat, telephony, workflow execution, and other external communications are not exposed by this discovery alias.

blocked.label: Administer Freshsales Suite
blocked.description: Plans, marketing-contact allowances, workspaces, migrations, users, roles, territories, domains, channels, billing, app installation, and account configuration remain outside this alias.

blocked.label: Use private or raw Suite interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, account passwords, session cookies, private endpoints, arbitrary raw requests, and undocumented cross-product synchronization are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Freshsales and Freshmarketer
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Suite action is enabled because the source identifies Freshworks' combined sales and marketing product rather than an additional public API authority.

runtimeSupport.description: No umbrella Freshsales Suite tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Freshsales or Freshmarketer provider for its exact supported authority.
No umbrella Freshsales Suite tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Freshsales or Freshmarketer provider for its exact supported authority.

providerSetup.blocker: Freshworks describes Freshsales Suite as the integrated combination of Freshsales sales CRM and Freshmarketer marketing automation, chat, and telephony with one customer record. Its developer portal publishes the Freshsales/Freshworks CRM API using a user's API key and bundle alias at the customer's myfreshworks.com CRM instance; it does not publish a separate Freshsales Suite credential, callback, scope set, API base, resource identity, or tool surface. Freshworks also documents product-specific Suite feature families such as Freshsales sales sequences and Freshmarketer marketing journeys. A third Suite connection would duplicate or blur the canonical provider authorities and make high-impact communication permissions ambiguous.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this suite slug non-installable and route discovery by intent: use canonical Freshsales for its approved sales CRM and shared-record contract, and canonical Freshmarketer only for its independently documented and approved marketing contract. Preserve each provider's exact credentials, customer instance binding, plan and role checks, tools, Safe and Dangerously skip permissions profiles, installs, and audit identity. Revisit only if Freshworks publishes a distinct Suite-level authorization and resource contract that cannot be represented through those canonical providers.

evidence.supports: Freshworks presents Freshsales Suite as one CRM experience combining sales and marketing automation with chat, telephony, shared customer context, and AI-assisted engagement.
Freshworks lists Freshsales, Freshsales Suite, and Freshmarketer as related CRM offerings and describes the Suite as uniting sales and marketing rather than as a separate developer API product.

Freshworks defines the Suite as combining sales CRM, marketing automation, chat, and telephony in one instance; migrations merge Freshsales and Freshmarketer records and require existing API integrations and apps to be retargeted rather than creating a third Suite integration type.

The official CRM API uses a user-owned API key plus bundle alias on the customer's myfreshworks.com CRM instance and documents contacts, marketing lists, accounts, deals, notes, activities, products, documents, files, configuration, and custom modules without a separate Suite authentication contract.

Freshworks documents sales sequences as a Freshsales and Suite feature and marketing journeys as a Freshmarketer and Suite feature, showing that the commercial Suite combines distinct product capability families.
Freshworks publishes shared service, privacy, developer, marketplace, and acceptable-use terms that continue to govern the canonical product integrations.
